what: Reproduction checks of the frozen rebuilds (PLAN.md D45). Generated by tools/frozen_common.py.
rule: A rebuild is used only when passed is true. Predictions are compared with stored predictions; no held-out outcome is read and no held-out metric is computed.

checks.name: absence
checks.compared: the frozen scorer (analytics.load.train.score_absence) on the rows of oof.parquet, with the numbers reports/load.md prints for the absence candidates; each within half of its last printed digit

checks.name: embeddings
checks.compared: the player counts and the 5-NN position accuracy with its interval in the rebuilt report, with reports/embeddings.md; printed values must be identical, and every generated section the same line for line

checks.name: epv
checks.compared: predictions of the rebuilt GRU for the stored 1 Hz states of the held-out games against the stored epv_points ($DATA_ROOT/analytics/epv/heldout); predictions with predictions, no outcome column read, nothing scored

checks.name: ghosting
checks.compared: ghost positions of the rebuilt MLP for the held-out games, rolled forward from their tracking frames, against the stored ghost_x and ghost_y at both horizons ($DATA_ROOT/analytics/ghosting/heldout); predictions with predictions, no outcome column read, nothing scored

checks.name: xfg
checks.compared: predictions of the rebuilt hgb_contest_prior (the saved parts, read back from model.pkl) for the held-out feature rows, with the stored p_selected of the held-out rows of $DATA_ROOT/analytics/xfg/2015-16/xfg_predictions.parquet; no outcome column is read
